_note: Numbers invented for the damage, time, crit, streak and enemy-skip rules (owner B, missions 2-5). Check them. min_enemy_damage: an enemy hit never does less than this. rounding: round = half goes up, floor = always down, ceil = always up. time_limit_seconds: seconds per question by difficulty. typed_extra_seconds: extra seconds for a typed answer. min_time_limit_seconds: a heavy weapon takes seconds away, but a question never gets less time than this. crit_difficulties: only questions of these difficulties can be a crit (26 Nov 2026: easy questions were taken out, then put back the same day, because the game felt too hard and players should feel themselves winning; remove "easy" to turn it off again). crit_tiers: an answer that uses at most this share of its time limit is a crit; checked from the fastest. The share is measured on the normal time limit, without the seconds that items add (26 Nov 2026: made tighter after the play-test, was 0.15 and 0.30). streak: bonus_per_right for each right answer in a row, up to max_multiplier. enemy_skip_chance: chance the enemy skips its turn after a miss. utility: war_cry_bonus boosts the next attack; reveal_wrong_choices_removed removes wrong choices from the next multiple-choice question; evasion_attacks sets how many enemy attacks are covered; evasion_miss_chance is the chance a covered attack misses. habits: the spammer rule in ai/habits.py; using the same move spam_turns turns in a row makes the enemy's damage x spam_damage, once per enemy. Weak-spot rule: after min_moves answers, an asked topic with mastery below weak_below makes the enemy ask about it (checked before the spammer rule; still one change per enemy). Speed rule (checked last): when the last fast_answers answers were all right and took on average less than fast_ratio of expected_answer_seconds (progression.json; 0.15 x 20 s = 3 s, crit speed: was 0.3, but then average players set it off about 10 times a run), the enemy's HP is x fast_hp. move_effects: a move with "effect": "stun" in moves.json (Shield Bash) stuns with stun_chance when it hits: the enemy loses its next turn. "effect": "poison" (Poison Arrow) poisons when it hits: poison_damage at the start of each of the enemy's next poison_turns turns (also a turn it loses; if the poison kills it, it does not attack); a new poison starts the count again, it does not add up (numbers from the design doc). Tier damage and bonus_damage are in moves.json; enemy damage is in enemies.json.
